label: Skyr
comment: A fresh sour milk cheese, though eaten as yoghurt is: the curd of skimmed milk, set with a little rennet besides, strained as quark is.
step: what is left when the whey goes

about.text: Skyr is a traditional Icelandic cultured dairy product. It has the consistency of strained yogurt, but a milder flavor. Skyr can be classified as a fresh sour milk cheese, similar to curd cheese consumed like a yogurt in the Baltic states, the Low Countries and Germany. It has been a part of Icelandic cuisine for centuries.

how.text: Skimmed milk is set by lactic acid bacteria, sometimes helped by a little rennet, and then strained hard, so the result is a fat-free but very high-protein, thick curd.

steps.note: A little rennet is added, and a yeast active at low temperature makes it skyr rather than yoghurt.
The whey is removed until the protein is at least 8 %.
